name: Chris Pimentel
office: City of El Segundo, Member of the City Council

items.text: Chris Pimentel is the mayor of El Segundo, first elected to the City Council in 2018 and chosen as mayor in 2024. He is a technology executive and former Marine Corps infantry officer. He chairs the regional Transportation Committee and the L.A. County Sanitation Districts.

sentences.text: Chris Pimentel is the mayor of El Segundo, first elected to the City Council in 2018 and chosen as mayor in 2024.
He is a technology executive and former Marine Corps infantry officer.
He chairs the regional Transportation Committee and the L.A. County Sanitation Districts.

items.text: He says he has helped grow the general fund and maintain reserves while keeping taxes low. He says the city over-invests in infrastructure, such as synced street lights and emergency response times under three minutes. He has called for modernizing municipal codes and treating industrial capacity as a civic asset rather than a zoning hurdle. He says the city emphasizes clear and transparent regulation to support businesses.
